facts.fact: 基特说索伦已整一周没来找他，上次是在厨房。
facts.anchor: It’s been a full week since Soren last came for me. The last time was in the kitchen.

facts.fact: 基特心里数着那是第四次，而且过去三周索伦只碰他一个人。
facts.anchor: Four. And for the past three weeks he hasn’t touched anyone else, only me.

facts.fact: 基特转身，正对上一堵肌肉墙，索伦已站在他身后。
facts.anchor: I turn slowly, cautiously… and come face-to-chest with a solid wall of muscle.

facts.fact: 索伦蹲下双手托住基特大腿，把他整个人抱离地面。
facts.anchor: What I don’t expect is for him to suddenly bend down, slide both hands under my thighs, and scoop me clean off the floor.

facts.fact: 上楼途中索伦踩空一步，身体向后倾，又及时站稳。
facts.anchor: Halfway up he misjudges a step. For one terrifying second his balance tips backward and I feel us starting to go.

facts.fact: 基特被抱进三楼双开门内，发现这是索伦真正的卧室。
facts.anchor: I’m standing in Soren Sinclair’s actual bedroom.

facts.fact: 索伦从抽屉取出黑色丝绸眼罩和一条叠好的领带，蒙住基特眼睛并绑住他双手。
facts.anchor: I dig through the top drawer until I find what I want; a soft black silk sleeping mask and one of my neatly folded ties.

facts.fact: 基特射精时，索伦扯掉他的眼罩；两人对视，索伦随之射在他体内。
facts.anchor: Oh, fuck this, I reach up and rip the mask off his eyes.
